name: crew-dispatch
description: A dispatch board (/ms-crew-dispatch) that routes subagents to a model and an effort by agent type, from a table you set in /config or on the board, and lists what each subagent of the session ran on and why.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Apply the table to new subagents. Off, every subagent runs as it would without the mod; your rows are kept and the board still lists each dispatch

generalPurposeModel.title: general-purpose model
